note_en: 连…都/也… means "even": 连 puts the most surprising item up front, and 都 or 也 before the verb confirms it is included. In the text: 连充电器都换成了更小的新款 "even the charger had been swapped for a smaller new one," and 连撬棒都插不进去 "you couldn't even get a pry tool in." English just adds "even," but Chinese needs both halves of the frame.
